definitions.gloss: amount of exercise; level of physical activity
definitions.explanation: The quantity or intensity of physical exercise a person engages in.
In physics, the product of an object's mass and velocity.

examples.japanese: {運動量|うんどうりょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{足|た}りない→足りる：01209_tariru⟧。
⟦{毎日|まいにち}→毎日：00729_mainichi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{運動量|うんどうりょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{増|ふ}やす→増やす：02410_fuyasu⟧ことにした。
examples.english: I decided to increase my daily amount of exercise.

examples.japanese: ⟦{医者|いしゃ}→医者：02847_isha⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{運動量|うんどうりょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{減|へ}らす→減らす：02414_herasu⟧よう⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{言|い}われた→言う：00515_iu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦なかなか→なかなか：01547_nakanaka⟧⟦{難|むずか}しい→難しい：00517_muzukashii⟧。
examples.english: The doctor told me to reduce my level of physical activity, but it's not easy.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{運動|うんどう}→運動：00821_undou⟧ (exercise; motion) and ⟦{量|りょう}→量：03799_ryou⟧ (quantity, amount). In everyday conversation, sense 1 (amount of exercise) is far more common. The physics sense (momentum) is used in academic and technical contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {運動量|うんどうりょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧: a lot of exercise
- {運動量|うんどうりょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{少|すく}ない→少ない：01136_sukunai⟧: little exercise
- {運動量|うんどうりょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{増|ふ}やす→増やす：02410_fuyasu⟧: to increase physical activity
- {運動量|うんどうりょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{減|へ}らす→減らす：02414_herasu⟧: to reduce physical activity
- ⟦{一日|いちにち}→一日：00942_ichinichi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{運動量|うんどうりょう}: daily amount of exercise
- {運動量|うんどうりょう}⟦{保存|ほぞん}→保存：03626_hozon⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{法則|ほうそく}→法則：05143_housoku⟧: law of conservation of momentum

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{運動|うんどう}→運動：00821_undou⟧: exercise, physical activity — the activity itself, not the quantity
- {活動量|かつどうりょう}: amount of activity — broader than exercise, includes all physical activity
